doc: Persistent named blobs (save games, battery RAM, settings) that outlive the instance and the session. The host gives each guest its own namespace; the guest only names blobs inside it. A write replaces the whole blob and is persisted before it returns.

constants.name: MAX_TOTAL_BYTES
constants.doc: all blobs of a namespace together (the Eden host keeps a namespace in one engine storage of at most 5 MB, base64-encoded)

constants.name: ERR_RANGE
constants.doc: offset is negative or past the end of the blob

constants.name: ERR_FULL
constants.doc: the write would take the namespace past MAX_TOTAL_BYTES

constants.name: ERR_IO
constants.doc: the host could not persist the change (engine storage limits or errors); the previous content is kept

constants.name: ERR_NAME
constants.doc: the name is empty or longer than MAX_NAME

functions.name: size
functions.doc: Size of the blob in bytes, or ERR_NOT_FOUND / ERR_NAME.

functions.name: read
functions.doc: Copies bytes [offset, offset + cap) of the blob (fewer at its end) into dst. Returns the number of bytes copied, or ERR_NOT_FOUND / ERR_RANGE / ERR_NAME.

functions.name: write
functions.doc: Replaces the blob with data (creating it) and persists it. Returns OK or ERR_FULL / ERR_IO / ERR_NAME.

functions.name: remove
functions.doc: Deletes the blob and persists the change. Returns OK or ERR_NOT_FOUND / ERR_IO / ERR_NAME.
